Create a completely NEW original illustration from scratch for the fantasy game card "Ser Kev's Thorn Buster" in La Rata Remix. Landscape 4:3, ideally 1448x1086. NO text, title, card frame, logos, UI or watermark. No previous illustration is supplied or to be recreated.

Scene: a crowned gray rat drives a compact BLACK ROYAL SEDAN through a ruined Spire street, leans from its open side window with a brass flamethrower burning green thorns, while its securely attached RIGHT FRONT TIRE rolls over one enemy foot. Comic non-graphic slapstick, no blood. Rich hand-painted Slay the Spire 2 fantasy card illustration: bold sculpted shapes, confident dark outlines, expressive silhouettes, deep navy and violet shadows, orange firelight, readable emerald brambles. NOT a realistic automotive advertisement, not glossy 3D.

Compose an entirely fresh clean silhouette: car seen from a modestly elevated FRONT-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER view, front pointing toward image right. Show the grille and the RIGHT flank, defined from the forward-facing driver's perspective. The near-side FRONT wheel is on the right side of the car. Vehicle has right-hand drive so the crowned rat and the foot contact are both on this visible side.

The car MUST read as a normal compact four-door THREE-BOX NOTCHBACK SEDAN. A black angular luxury saloon translated into the chunky fantasy universe. Clear hood, lower separate cabin, CLEAR SHORT HORIZONTAL TRUNK projecting behind the steep rear window. Two seat rows, normal wheelbase. Short roof ends before trunk. Restrained dark brass trim. NO station wagon, estate, hatchback, tall roof, SUV, hearse, stretched limousine or carriage. No real Mercedes shape copied literally, no real brand symbol, no hood ornament. Wheels normal size, hubs centered under the wheel arches; upper portions visibly tucked behind the fenders. Near front and rear wheels parallel, equal coherent orientation. Straight attached front wheel, no floating/tilted/dislocated tire, no bent suspension. Body remains level.

The rat has a gray whiskered muzzle, round pink ears, gold crown with green gem, burgundy royal collar. Head and one shoulder emerge FROM THE OPEN NEAR FRONT SIDE WINDOW, body seated inside. One paw steers inside; other paw holds a short single-barrel flamethrower THROUGH the SIDE WINDOW above its sill. Its muzzle and the continuous flame jet are outside the car, aimed outward-forward toward a thorn barricade. The windshield and ALL OTHER WINDOWS are opaque black smoked glass.

FOREGROUND ENEMY AND FOOT GEOMETRY IS CRITICAL: place the enemy OUTSIDE the near RIGHT flank alongside the rat's OPEN WINDOW and near FRONT wheel, fully in FRONT OF the car silhouette in depth, never behind the hood or on the far side. Use the actual Damp Cultist enemy visual identity from Slay the Spire 2: hunched humanoid in heavy ragged dark blue/teal robes, pale turquoise long beaked skull-like face with small pink barnacle/coral growths, dark hollow eye sockets, thin greenish limbs and broad bare feet; rope belt. NOT a green muscular orc, not a generic goblin, not a classic feathered bird Cultist. Its startled upper body is to the outer foreground side, leaving the rat visible. One clearly continuous visible leg descends from the robe to an ankle next to the front tire. Its flat foot extends onto the roadway UNDER the bottom tread of this SAME near right-front tire. Tire hides the mid-foot; toes stick out a little beyond the forward contact edge. Clear dark contact shadow, slight cartoon flattening. The whole wheel remains firmly seated within its arch with normal round shape. No separate limb, no foot on the hood, no foot behind a different wheel. Separate the creature silhouette from the flame; flames burn thorns, not its body.

All three beats must read at card thumbnail size: royal rat in open side window, orange jet destroying green thorns, attached front tire pressing on connected monster foot. Keep these inside central 85% of canvas for rounded card crop. Simplify background and excess ornaments. Prioritize coherent tire/arch/foot/leg construction and unmistakable short-trunk sedan silhouette.
